report:
Reviewed the complete claim and all six implementation associations plus the sole associated TODO test. The claim permits dependencies on parsed identities, macro lookup/definitions, generated text and completeness, while excluding checked item signatures, trait solutions and function bodies. local_expanded_module_items reads unexpanded identities and delegates to attribute/derive/bang expansion; its recursive lookup uses the MacroExpansion resolver with empty ribs and combines named and glob identity candidates. It does not invoke body checking, signature lowering, or solving. The new named-filter and import ambiguity code does not change that boundary: MacroExpansion selects NamedLookup::All, which returns true without inspecting generated origin; the generated-origin audit is a separate final import-diagnostics operation. Identity deduplication hashes Symbols, not semantic contents.

For each remaining association: LocalMacroInvocationSym::parse_output reads invocation syntax/input and selected macro definition, expands to text, and parses generated items; MacroDefSymbol::expand reads local macro RHS tokens (macro definition input, not a checked function body) or the external proc-macro service; DeriveExpansion::parse_output/builtin_derive_output read the selected source item and expansion identity and parse emitted items; expand_builtin_derive examines parsed structure/field names and emits source, without calling signatures or trait solving. Its builtin_derive_trait helper consults external definition/export identities only. Unsupported active attributes, derives and bang expansions remain completeness inputs, not a reason to demand semantic checking. SymExt name/children helpers use metadata export identities. The captured scope/ribs helpers expose module identity and empty lexical lookup for this phase. The captured enum_variants helper builds identities from parsed variant CST without calling the separate enum sig method. Captured LocalUseSym separates parsed imports/attributes from the new diagnostics method; expansion lookup calls the former, never diagnostics. Macro definition storage confirms RHS tokens are their own tracked field.

The complete test set consists only of todo::modules_expand_dependencies. Its explicit matrix defers executable evidence for cold/warm expansion query traces, invocation/selected-output invalidation, body-only and unrelated-signature non-invalidation, and backdating before downstream execution. This is a justified visible deferral: those guarantees need incremental edit fixtures and query-boundary assertions; ordinary one-shot differential macro tests do not establish them. No behavioral test is claimed by that empty TODO body. Current source inspection supports the checked-detail firewall, but does not establish the deferred incremental invalidation behavior. No N/A evidence or other associated tests exist. This review executed review start/read commands and inspected their captured source; it did not execute behavioral tests or infer coverage from a passing suite. No source changes were made by this reviewer. No new dependency-boundary violation was found; retain the existing TODO status until the stated trace matrix is implemented.
